localPhrase.original: Bonjour, je découvre Paris à pied.
localPhrase.transliteration: Bon-zhoor, zhuh day-koovr Pa-ree ah pyay.
localPhrase.gloss: Hello, I am discovering Paris on foot.
localPhrase.pronunciation: bon-ZHOOR, zhuh day-KOOVR pah-REE ah PYAY

dialogue.speaker: npc
dialogue.text: Bonjour! Are you finding your way from the station?

dialogue.speaker: traveler
dialogue.text: Bonjour. Yes, I am discovering Paris on foot.

dialogue.speaker: npc
dialogue.text: Follow the canal for a quieter start. The city changes pace beside the water.

dialogue.speaker: traveler
dialogue.text: That sounds better than rushing straight to the famous view.

dialogue.speaker: npc
dialogue.text: There is time for the market, a café, and the river before evening.

dialogue.speaker: traveler
dialogue.text: Merci, Camille. I will let the streets lead me there.

notebookLines: The station opened onto pale stone and a long morning pavement.
Canal water made the city feel quieter without making it still.
An iron footbridge held the middle of the view for a few steps.
The market lane traded grand facades for flowers, produce and small doors.
Lunch arrived as a pause at the edge of a Left Bank side street.
The best parts of the route were the changes in scale between each district.
The Seine widened the horizon just as the light began to soften.
At night, the same riverside view felt newly drawn in blue and gold.
voteBlurb: Station boulevards, canal paths, market passages and the Seine, ending beneath the evening lights.

postcard.title: Evening beside the Seine
postcard.copy: Ten Paris places later, the river opened and the tower caught the last light.
